text: {"lessons":["My account has fluctuated despite no trades, reinforcing that short-term price changes are unpredictable and not a reason to chase recent moves.","Doing nothing has avoided impulsive trading, but I should still review whether my holdings and cash allocation fit my goals and risk tolerance.","Because losses weigh heavily on me and I check infrequently, I should use a deliberate, sustainable plan rather than react to each monthly change."]}
